stem: In what way is the narrator in the story “Last Dance” UNLIKE the speaker of the poem “The Tree”?
instruction: Use Last Dance and The Tree to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: The narrator spends most of her time alone, but the speaker is surrounded by others.

options.label: B
options.text: The narrator has a lot of time to sit and think, but the speaker is too busy to take time for reflection.

options.label: C
options.text: The narrator knows her sister has not permanently left home yet, but the speaker sees that the tree is already gone.

options.label: D
options.text: The narrator has spent her whole life with her sister, but the speaker has only lived by the tree for a short amount of time.
